Now I'll create a query that counts how many times each musical style appears as 1st, 2nd, or 3rd preference.

args.sql:
SELECT 
    ms.StyleName AS Musical_Style,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN 1 END) AS First_Preference_Count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN 1 END) AS Second_Preference_Count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 3 THEN 1 END) AS Third_Preference_Count,
    COUNT(*) AS Total_Preferences
FROM 
    entertainmentagency.main.Musical_Preferences mp
JOIN 
    entertainmentagency.main.Musical_Styles ms ON mp.StyleID = ms.StyleID
WHERE 
    mp.PreferenceSeq IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY 
    ms.StyleName, ms.StyleID
ORDER BY 
    Total_Preferences DESC;
